That dataset stores the target as “median house value” in units of **$100 000**.  
If you take the mean of all 20 640 target values you get:

```
mean_target ≈ 3.0   # in $100 000 units
```

Multiplying by 100 000 gives an average median house value of roughly **$300 000**.  

So, according to the California Housing dataset, the average median house price in California is about **$300 k**.
